## About

tadejs's fork of Caduceus for E-P7 carries a port to the original OM-5 (2022, firmware 1.2). It is a separate project from Caduceus for OM-5, which targets the Mark II and has no working build for the original body. The fork's main branch is an unchanged copy of the E-P7 project; the OM-5 work is on the om5-port branch and its open pull request.

The port notes read the OM-5 firmware after expanding its two LZ4-compressed parts of the main program, and find the Color Profile 1–3 and Monochrome Profile 1–3 settings still in the firmware, renumbered from the E-P7's, with the colour builder intact but no Picture Mode entries or editor screen to reach them.

On the owner's camera, the official 1.2 file through the SD updater, the port's own LZ4 re-encoding, a firmware-screen label, a no-op half-press hook and a card read from that hook all passed. A first COLOR 1–3 back end lets each profile supply its own saturation, but only in the emulator; the profiles cannot yet be chosen on the camera.

### What it's working towards

- Picture Mode entries, labels and a profile selector so that COLOR 1–3 can be chosen on the camera.
- Per-profile contrast, sharpness and the other profile values, beyond saturation.
- One shared look format and Control Panel with the other Caduceus ports.

> **Before you install:** Installing modified firmware is at your own risk. Follow the project's own guide for your exact camera and firmware, and read its safety notes first.

## Research notes

The owner reports five camera test steps (C1–C5) passed on an original OM-5 on 1.2. The COLOR 1–3 back end has run only in the emulator, and nothing has been released. The work is on branch om5-port; main is an unchanged copy of Caduceus for E-P7.
